artboards.title: Add a quote — the assignee's screen

annotations.text:
Direction: clinical instrument.
One signal colour (teal) for "this needs you", one alarm colour (red) reserved for time only, one flag (amber) for what a quote IS rather than how urgent it is. The signature device is the indicator lamp — same shape and meaning on every screen.

Start at The system, bottom right.
The worklist now groups by Progress — the term already in CONTEXT.md — with Submission missed pinned above it as the one exception. Urgency moved from the group headings onto the row, as a lamp.
The internal-quote reminder currently links to /tenders/{id}, the owner's comparison sheet. It should link here instead — app-links.ts already has tenderItem(), it is just unused by reminders.
